newsitem.title: CHINA: China '96 cotton output at 4.2 mln T, down 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: China '96 cotton output at 4.2 mln T, down 11.7 pct.

text.p: China produced 4.2 million tonnes of cotton in 1996, down 11.7 percent from the previous year, Zhang Sai, director of the State Stastistical Bureau said on Friday.
Official estimates had previously put China's cotton output at 4.0 million tonnes in 1996, down by 800,000 tonnes from the previous year.
Zhang attributed the difference to difficulties in collecting data across the huge country.
China's 1997 acreage under cotton has been estimated at 4.56 million hectares, down by 4.2 percent year-on-year and the lowest level in 10 years.
China imported 650,000 tonnes of cotton in 1996, down 12.2 percent from the previous year, customs figures showed. Exports were 4,493 tonnes, down 79.2 percent.
